name: sface

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test

//: express, zod and tsx are runtime dependencies of the service, not build tools. They were in devDependencies, which meant an npm ci --omit=dev on the VPS produced a server that could not start. The SDK is pinned rather than tracking latest, because its published surface is what src/nimiq is written against.
